subject: Aurora Health: buying lanes, invoice handoff & security checklist
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Lowe <michael.lowe@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Aurora Health: buying lanes, invoice handoff & security checklist

Hi Michael —

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciate the candid run-through of Aurora's use case and the key decision criteria (latency under 300ms, model isolation for PHI, and predictable unit cost for embeddings). As promised, attaching our vendor onboarding checklist to speed procurement.

Quick recap and asks to move to SOW/PO:
- Economic buyer / finance approver: can you confirm the right person (name & email)? You mentioned Dana Reed in passing — is she our contact for final signoff?
- Procurement contact: who will own vendor intake (PO template, W9, remit-to)?
- Security evidence: you flagged SOC 2 and an on-prem handling addendum — does Aurora need an in-person audit or will our existing SOC 2 report + DPA suffice?
- Timeline: what is a realistic target for PO issuance after we deliver SOW + quote? (example: 2 weeks, 4 weeks)

Next steps from our side:
- I can circulate a first-draft SOW + pricing (light pilot: 50k tokens/mo, 3-month pilot) by EOD Monday.
- Marissa (Sales Ops) will prepare the quote and canonical billing lines.
- If you can loop in procurement/legal we can parallelize the review.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (template)

Thanks — 
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

From: Michael Lowe <michael.lowe@aurorahealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora Health: buying lanes, invoice handoff & security checklist

Sofia — thanks for the follow-up and the checklist, that helps. Looping in the details you asked for:

- Economic buyer / approver: Dana Reed <dana.reed@aurorahealth.com> (VP Finance). She signs larger commitments; smaller pilots can be approved by Procurement with Finance visibility.
- Procurement intake: procurement@aurorahealth.com (AP/Procurement team) handles PO templates, W9, remit, and tax details.
- Legal: contracts go to legalcontracts@aurorahealth.com — they will want to see a DPA and a redline of standard terms.

PO/invoice expectations:
- Typical cadence: once SOW + final quote are received, Procurement routes to Finance — target 10-21 business days to issue a PO for straightforward pilots.
- Payment terms: net-45 is standard for us; we can discuss net-30 if needed but would need Finance signoff.

Security and compliance:
- We require a current SOC 2 Type II report for vendors with access to PHI. If you can share the report and a DPA, Legal will triage. We do sometimes need an addendum around data segmentation for on-prem or VPC deployments — I noted your private deployment option on the call.

I've attached our standard PO template (Aurora_PO_Template.pdf) and a short AP checklist. If you can send the draft SOW and the quote that includes the billing code (if you have one), we can confirm the account code to include on the PO.

-Michael
Michael Lowe
Director, Platform Integrations — Aurora Health
michael.lowe@aurorahealth.com | (212) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Lowe <michael.lowe@aurorahealth.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora Health: buying lanes, invoice handoff & security checklist

Michael / Sofia — thanks for the details. Looping in Ben (CS) for delivery notes and Jonas (Legal) for the contracting path. I attached a preliminary quote for the pilot so we have an itemized set of billing lines to include on the PO (redwood_quote_20280614.pdf).

Action items / clarifying questions from Redwood Ops:
1) Sofia — we'll draft the SOW. Can you confirm the pilot scope in one paragraph (primary metrics, expected volumes, pilot success criteria) so we can be precise? Deadline: Monday 6/17 noon PT.
2) Finance/Procurement — Michael, when Procurement issues the PO, does Aurora want a single consolidated invoice for the pilot or monthly invoices tied to actual usage? (We can do either; monthly gives clearer usage accounting but adds cadence.)
3) Legal — Jonas, once we have the DPA + SOC 2, will you be able to do a quick triage / redline within 3 business days? Please flag any non-standard indemnity/data-residency asks.

Proposed next steps (to keep timeline tight):
- Sofia: SOW draft to Michael + procurement@aurorahealth.com by Mon 6/17 EOD.
- Marissa: final quote to Sofia today for inclusion.
- Michael / Procurement: confirm remit-to and W9 receiver so we can attach to the onboarding packet.

If Proc can aim to route the PO within ~10 business days of receiving final SOW + quote, we can target a pilot start in early July. Please confirm if that aligns.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0178

From: Procurement Ops <procurement@aurorahealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Michael Lowe <michael.lowe@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora Health: buying lanes, invoice handoff & security checklist

Hi Sofia / Marissa —

Thanks — Procurement confirms the following to keep the intake moving:
- Please include the Aurora billing code and cost center on the SOW/quote. If you don’t have it, we will supply on receipt of the draft.
- Remit-to and W9: we require vendor W9 + remit-to address to complete vendor setup.
- PO template attached: Aurora_PO_Template.pdf (use this as your cover doc).
- Invoice cadence: AP prefers a single monthly invoice tied to usage for pilots. We can consider consolidated invoices for one-off fixed-fee pilots if clearly called out in the SOW.
- Security evidence: SOC 2 Type II + executed DPA required before production access. For pilot access to a private VPC, include a short note in the SOW describing data segmentation and control plane access.

Please send: SOW + itemized quote + W9 + remit-to address. Once received we will acknowledge and aim to issue a PO within 10 business days, pending Finance approval.

Procurement Ops
Aurora Health Accounts Payable
procurement@aurorahealth.com
